description: Extracts patch notes, DLC details, and game information from www.totalwar.com (official Total War site) via direct HTTP access with Next.js content decoding.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_patch_notes: 从URL获取补丁说明/更新文章内容; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_dlc_info: 从URL获取DLC扩展包详细信息; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_game_info: 从URL获取游戏主页信息; 参数: url; 必填: url

url.description:
要抓取的www.totalwar.com页面完整URL。
示例:
  - https://www.totalwar.com/news/total-war-warhammer-iii-update-210
  - https://www.totalwar.com/games/total-war-warhammer-iii/total-war-warhammer-iii-thrones-of-decay
  - https://www.totalwar.com/games/total-war-warhammer-iii/
